one_liner: Vercel has a broad REST API authenticated with self-serve access tokens that work on the free Hobby plan, and it has an official remote MCP server.
auth_notes: Access tokens are created at vercel.com/account/tokens with Full Account, Team or Project scope. Sign in with Vercel offers an OAuth/OIDC authorization-code flow, but it is identity-oriented. Integrations use OAuth too, and the evidence doesn't show that it covers the main REST API for self-serve apps. So the access token is the primary method.
access_notes: A free Hobby plan account can create an access token and call the REST API. The getting-started guide requires only a Vercel account. The evidence doesn't say explicitly that the API works on Hobby, so this is inferred.
